cur:catacombs-arles-farewell.summary: A crowded relief shows Christ at the centre among the apostles who press around him, with smaller figures kneeling below. The museum identifies the subject as Christ's farewell to his apostles.
facts: The museum describes the piece as an 'element of a sarcophagus representing Christ's farewell to his apostles'.
A separate small fragment is mounted at its upper left.
cur:catacombs-arles-farewell.notes: The identification of the subject follows the museum's title.
